category_title: Advanced students acting as peer mentors
scenario_title: Peer mentoring with unique Khan Academy problems
minimal_context: The advanced student mentor is walking around the class helping peers with unique math problems on Khan Academy.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please walk around the class and help your peers with their Khan Academy assignments.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I am walking around helping my peers. One of them just asked me for help since I am more math-savvy.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Because each student has unique problems, this isn't a typical peer-to-peer exchange of correct answers.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: We are forced to work through the problem together, but I am getting stuck trying to figure out how to share procedural advice and provide guidance rather than just giving them the actual solution.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Please walk around the class and help your peers with their Khan Academy assignments.

STUDENT: I am walking around helping my peers. One of them just asked me for help since I am more math-savvy.

TUTOR: How is the interaction going?

STUDENT: Because each student has unique problems, this isn't a typical peer-to-peer exchange of correct answers.

TUTOR: What are you doing then?

STUDENT: We are forced to work through the problem together, but I am getting stuck trying to figure out how to share procedural advice and provide guidance rather than just giving them the actual solution.

task.content: helping their peers with unique problems

context.materials: Khan Academy, data from Khan Academy
context.social_setting: student mentors walking around helping their peers

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Because each student had unique problems
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: forced to work through the problem together, and were more likely to share procedural advice than actual solutions

behavior_patterns.condition: ask a more math-savvy peer for help
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: transformed the typical peer-to-peer interaction from the exchange of correct answers to one of facilitation and guidance
